decisions.reason: As a core safety-shoe line that gained its own page by 2024, it reflects visible investment and a stronger public commitment that management is likely to continue backing.
This comfort insole remains only lightly featured and is less central than full footwear lines, but as a complementary offer management can still justify keeping it in the range.
The supportive insole has limited visible commitment and sits at the edge of the firm's core business, yet sunk development effort and fit with the footwear system still favor continuation.
The ergonomic safety shoe series had a dedicated page in both years and is tightly aligned with the firm's innovation and workplace-needs narrative, making withdrawal unlikely.
Firefighter and rescue boots moved from a mention to a dedicated page, suggesting rising commitment in a specialized protective-footwear niche the firm is likely to keep pursuing.
The moulded insole stayed on the home page and was backed by a concrete customer-use result, giving management both public justification and evidence to continue the product.
